policy: Record baseline limitations separately from native defects. A broader guarantee requires explicit design review and dedicated acceptance.

limitations.behavior: Capture detects changes per file; the whole working tree is not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Preserve per-file change detection and upload digest checks; do not advertise global atomicity.

limitations.behavior: Frozen v1 include scan roots follow symlink components: linked/** and linked/subdir/** can capture controlled files outside the project when linked points outside. Confirmed against the rebuilt frozen captureSnapshot implementation.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Preserve snapshot path safety by refusing symlink components in include scan roots. Focused native coverage checks both a symlink root and a symlink parent of the final scan directory. This source safety bug is separate from open native picomatch syntax gaps.

limitations.behavior: Build resource requests are scheduler reservations where the build executor cannot enforce cgroup limits.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Preserve documented reservation behavior and current executor limitations.

limitations.behavior: WorkdirSchema accepts C:relative while RelPathSchema rejects it; a parsed job spec alone does not establish safe materialization.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Capture parser behavior accurately and keep execution/materialization path validation independently safe; any workflow-visible tightening requires a recorded compatibility decision.

limitations.behavior: Jobs use existing container-based kinds; Mac worker support does not imply native macOS/Xcode jobs.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Keep worker tool requirements explicit and do not claim a host-process execution backend.

limitations.behavior: IDs order creations only to the millisecond; random suffixes within a millisecond are not monotonic. Group latest-attempt selection uses the lexicographically greatest job ID, so a same-millisecond retry can sort before its parent. FIFO ordering among same-millisecond jobs is also unspecified.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Preserve the frozen latest-ID rule and avoid claiming strict within-millisecond creation ordering. Monotonic generation or an attempt-based selection rule requires a separate compatibility decision.

limitations.behavior: The rejection handler attempts starting to queued, but the canonical transition table forbids it. A late rejection after starting does not requeue or fail the job.
limitations.nativeRequirement: Keep the canonical transition table; retain starting state and record a rejection diagnostic rather than inventing a new terminal outcome.
